title: Manijero reviewed passage set
description: Versioned contract for human-reviewed passages drawn from approved catalog documents. This file is the readable contract; backend/app/retrieval.py is the executable validator and must stay in sync with it. A passage set is a Git-tracked, human-reviewed artifact. Retrieval never downloads, parses, or chunks a document automatically: passages are written by a reviewer and only become searchable when their source_id resolves to a catalog entry that is approved, current, and unexpired. There is intentionally no canonical passages.json yet; a later reviewed ingestion feature produces it.

schema_version.description: Passage-set format version. Bump it, the schema, and the validator together in a reviewed change.

passages.description: Reviewed passages eligible for retrieval. An empty array is valid and intentional: it means no passage has been reviewed yet, not that the corpus is ready.

passage.description: One reviewed fragment of an approved catalog document. The excerpt is quoted, not summarized, and must not introduce a legal claim the document does not make.

id.description: Unique, stable, lowercase slug such as 'fixture-rd1048-art1-p1'. Never derive it from the excerpt text and never reuse it.

source_id.description: Catalog 'id' this passage was taken from. It must resolve to an existing catalog source; an unknown id is a load error, never a silent skip.

location.description: Article, annex, page, section, or equivalent location inside the document. Non-blank.

text.description: The reviewed excerpt. Non-blank. Retrieval indexes this text only.

critical.description: Optional flag marking this passage as carrying a deadline, amount, or threshold. When absent the source-level 'critical' flag applies.

applicability.description: Optional land applicability for this passage, recorded only when known. Leave the whole object absent when unknown; never infer it, and never use 'unknown' as a value. When absent the source-level applicability applies.

crop.description: Crop the passage applies to, for example 'olivar'.

water_regime.description: Water regime the passage applies to. Omit the key when unknown.

production_method.description: Production method the passage applies to. Omit the key when unknown.
